changes.summary: According to a 2025 survey of 2,000 U.S. adults by Pearl.com, a professional services platform, 19% said they lost more than $100 by following financial advice from an AI chatbot.

changes.title: Machine learning calibration of biosensors for microcystin toxin monitoring in freshwater
changes.summary: Portable screen-printed carbon electrode (SPCE) biosensors offer a rapid, low-cost way to detect microcystin-lysine-arginine (MC-LR), an extremely potent toxin produced by cyanobacteria during harmful algal blooms in freshwater. changes.title: Apple’s failed self-driving car program left a legacy of powerful AI chips
